newsitem.title: ITALY: Eni seen joining Albacom soon - Confalonieri.
newsitem.headline: Eni seen joining Albacom soon - Confalonieri.

text.p: Italian state controlled energy giant Eni is expected soon to enter the share structure of Albacom, a joint telecommunications venture between British Telecom, BNL and Mediaset, Mediaset's Fedele Confalonieri said.

Confalonieri, who is chairman of private Italian broadcaster Mediaset, told reporters at a news conference Eni had not yet signed a deal but that its entrance in Albacom should be via its gas subsidiary Snam.
Snam operates its own telecommunications network linked to its gas pipeline activities and negotiations have been underway for some months for Eni's entrance via Snam into Albacom.
Albacom combines BT's Italian telecommunications operations with the telecom activities of Banca Nazionale del Lavoro (BNL).
Mediaset, the television and advertising arm of Silvio Berlusconi's Fininvest media group joined the venture last year.
